title: pm(record-recognisers): close a fence only on a bare run, refuse a code-indented Contract review heading, and name the new Head-sha refusal causes
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by in-flight work. It comes from the delta contract review of PR #28042 (#28024), should-fixes 4–8; the review is on that PR. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** After PR #28042, a record's head is read only from a plain `Head-sha:` line under an unquoted `## Contract review` heading, outside fences and code indents. The review found two residual shapes. Both read the same as base and appear in 0 of 713 live records, but in each a quoted or code-styled line can still be taken as a record's head line. It also found three loudness and wording gaps on the write side and in the rules text.

**Reader who acts:** the PM recogniser tooling owner (skills lane).

## Measured (PR #28042 head `2e75b193`, 2026-10-30)

1. `FENCE_LINE` closes a fence on a run with trailing text (three backticks then prose). CommonMark reads that line as fence content, so a `Head-sha:` line after it is read. This is review should-fix 6; it behaves the same on base.
2. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` admits any leading whitespace, so a heading indented 4 spaces (which is a code block) opens the scope. The key line, by contrast, is held to 3 spaces. This is review should-fix 7: unchanged from base, 0 live instances.
3. `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` (in `post-stamped.mjs`) tests for the key anywhere in the comment, ignoring case. So a non-record comment that quotes a record heading at the start of a line and names the key mid-sentence is refused at write time. This is loudness only (review should-fix 4).
4. In `post-stamped.mjs`, the Head-sha refusal's `why` text (about :2097) and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` (about :2063) do not name the two new causes: a code-indented line, and a line under a quoted heading (review should-fix 8).
5. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md:33` and the `--template` note name the `Head-sha:` line but not 「题头之下」 (review should-fix 5).

## Wanted

- Items 1 and 2: close the fence only on a whitespace-only run of the same char and at least the opening length. Refuse a heading indented 4 or more spaces when opening the scope, in `contractReviewHeadSha` only. Pin both, and ablate each once.
- Items 3 and 4: wording and precision of the existing write-time refusal. ⛔ No new refusal class.
- Item 5: an in-line edit, line-neutral, on a governed path (Tier S, `.claude/**`, developed on fable per the project rule).
- ⛔ No new gate.

## Blocked-by

PR #28042 (the heading-scoped reader this tightens).

Blocked-by: #28042

## Dedupe

#28024 is the card PR #28042 closes. #28033 covers the "closed" wording for PR targets, not this reader. Searched the newest 100 open issues for "FENCE_LINE", "HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE" and "CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER": none.
